messages.subject: Error in gl.filter.rdepth - could not find function "gl.filter.rdepth"
parts:
Hi,

I've recently updated to a new version of R (4.0.0), re-downloaded all my packages and now gl.filter.rdepth function doesn't seem to be available.

I receive the following error when attempting to use this filtering function:


could not find function "gl.filter.rdepth"


Is there a way around this?

Thanks for any assistance.

messages.author: a3ea45e87285d820
messages.subject: Re: Error in gl.filter.rdepth - could not find function "gl.filter.rdepth"
parts:
Sorry Serina.

gl is just a placeholder.

NumbatRAW <- gl.compliance.check(NumbatRAW)

I do not think this will work though. You need to read your data in again with gl.read.dart() which is the script that calculates the read depths. I assume you have loaded saved data read in with an earlier version of gl.read.dart?

A
